data.body: **[P1] Claim payload failures before releasing the completion lock.** When this callback serializes a failed child, exception offloading can throw `PayloadOffloadException`. Because that happens inside `ChildContextOperation`'s `catch (Throwable)` body, its preceding payload-exception catch cannot claim the failure. This lock is then released with `completionInitiated` still false, allowing a waiting coordinator to checkpoint early success before `failInvocation` runs; replay can consequently skip the failed branch. Atomically claim the payload failure while holding this lock, and add a race test where exception offloading fails as another child satisfies early completion.
